name: 德雷克
desc: 德雷克，抑或“莫德雷德”，并不知晓第一次“出生”的具体日期，史书和传奇亦无记载。偶尔，当他试图忆起那张模糊的面容时，便会来到河边，久久凝望着顺流而下的水流，直至晨曦的露珠悄悄爬上他的裤脚。|第二次被迫“出生”时，他苏醒在一座崭新的古堡中。身旁所有人对他的祝语都是：“你便是莫德雷德。”但他依旧心有犹疑，并打翻了那瓶用来庆祝他苏醒的蜂蜜酒。|经过考量，德雷克决定将走出城堡那天定为他真正的“生日”。他坦然地告知了箱中伙伴们，并饶有兴趣地看着他们手忙脚乱地准备礼物。最后，他和小瑞安侬一道，用神秘术火焰烤出一块焦黑的蛋糕。
useDesc: 承载了珍贵记忆的彩色相片，可用于邀请此神秘学家。
desc2: 兀然苏醒的“古老”骑士，自我意志的坚守者，你最具反叛精神的朋友之一。

character_data.text:
神秘学家艺术品，展出于20世纪30年代，参展时长约19年，诞生时间不详。原参展地为大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国南部萨默塞特郡，后巡展于世界各地。
尺寸：67 23/32×64 11/64×22 7/16in.
介质：王国幻梦
香调：柑橘调 苦橙 橡木苔 克什米尔木
灵感：叛兽的决心[兽] 无名骑士

character_data.title: “命运和它的主人”
character_data.text: 传说里湖中仙女为选中之人赐下的圣剑，以及与之伴生的命运。有人听之任之，亦有人试图丢弃它，并被荆棘和火焰施以永恒的诅咒。对于后者，受访者不以为意。“这是美名，这是荣耀。”受访者道。

character_data.title: 骑士手甲
character_data.text: 做工精细，质地坚硬。这副手甲曾握过沾染王血的圣剑，也曾拿起被乡村雾气润湿的猎枪。受访者预言，有朝一日，它会触摸到更多事物——手枪、相机、战地摩托的把手……即那一切远离过去，奔向全新未来的事物。

character_data.title: “入队礼物”
character_data.text: 由刻雷乌斯配发给小队成员的一把芝诺军用手枪，足够利落，足够快速且先进。最重要的是，它做到了任何冷兵器都无法做到的事——在某种程度上，给了它的主人“自由”。

character_data.title: 圆桌之外的命运
character_data.text:
每当土地动荡、战乱不止时，那些头戴铁盔、手持长枪的士兵们总会希冀出现一位伟大的领袖，他能终结古不列颠的纷争，建立起平等的王国。那里将再无疾苦，闪烁着灵性的辉光，给予众人荫庇。
人类将目光投向马上的骑士，而血食怪、矮人、人鱼……众巫师亦翘首以盼，但骑士被刺穿胸膛，颓然倒下；他们将目光投向领主，但领主被另一个领主推翻，沦为土壤的肥料。
直到亚瑟王的出现。一切希冀成真。

在王那接纳高尚与平等、斥责歧视与不公的圆桌前，骑士们聚集而来。梅林为圆桌骑士们举行仪式，令他们得以窥见命运，沐浴于荣誉的力量中。骑士们立下誓言，承诺保护弱小、永不施暴、永不叛国。
授勋之时，一位圆桌骑士却窥见了不祥的命运。他环顾四周，灵性的辉光于圆桌上闪烁，王国巫师挥杖将此地照亮，他却唯独看见未被照亮的阴影。
骑士离开了圆桌，带走他稚嫩的尘酿鹰。

鹰唳之声再起时，骑士的剑已刺入亚瑟王的身体。永恒之王的国度分崩离析，圆桌四散分裂，骑士们仓皇回头，终觉分歧从未被抹平，人类与巫师再难端坐于一厅。

但，不是说亚瑟王还会苏醒，再次拯救不列颠吗？他真的会回来吗？
格拉斯顿伯里，一个稚嫩的声音发出疑问。
彼时，他还未洞见属于自己的命运。

character_data.title: 无名木雕
character_data.text:
三个无名的木雕，手法粗糙，雕刻随意，显是门外汉之作。雕刻者无意给它们取名。

【第一个没有名字的木雕，尽管有人称呼此类外形的物品为“剑”】
木雕原材料为山毛榉，外观与雕刻者所持长剑相似，剑身本体被雕刻得较为精细，但荆棘部分却略显潦草，甚至可以说是草草收尾。

……

【第二个没有名字的木雕，尽管有人称呼此类外形的物品为“手枪”】
木雕原材料为橡木，外观与勃朗宁M1903式手枪相似，且进行了手工抛光。虽抛光水平拙劣，但可见雕刻者用心。

……

【第三个没有名字的木雕，它没有被完成】
木雕原材料为一段枯死的树干，只依稀能看出它圆形的轮廓和表面篆刻至一半的纹路。
雕刻者似乎不打算完成它。

character_data.title: 名字的含义
character_data.text:
白雪松：……所以你最终决定为自己取名为德雷克？我们都知道这名字的含义与“龙”有关，它是否也与潘多拉贡家族有关呢？
德雷克：比起我的名字，我更好奇你的嘴。
德雷克：它看起来也跟其他人的嘴一模一样，这是否说明你和其他人也有一种密切的关系？
白雪松：当然。事实上，这正是我作为编辑的追求之一——《UTTU》既为读者，也为受访者发声。
白雪松：你可以自由选择回答的形式与内容，就我们目前的访谈来看，与传说相同——你与“叛逆”的特质息息相关。
德雷克：……
德雷克：从语言学的角度来说，这个名字的确和潘多拉贡有相似之处。
德雷克：从历史和传说的角度来说，全英国的人都和潘多拉贡家族有关系。
德雷克：基于这个角度，你可以再问一遍最开始的问题。
白雪松：你为什么决定为自己取名为德雷克？
德雷克：噢，其实没那么多含义，是我灵机一动。
白雪松：基于你刚才的发言，我认为这正源自你潜意识里对潘多拉贡家族的……
德雷克：女士，只是灵机一动。

character_voice.name: 初遇
character_voice.content: 这是属于“我”的第一个房间，一个真正意义上的归属之所。#0|我会记住它。#5.8
character_voice.encontent: So these are my private chambers, the first place I may truly call my own.#0|I shall hold this moment dear.#6.6

character_voice.name: 初遇
character_voice.content: 这是属于“我”的第一个房间，一个真正意义上的归属之所。#0|我会记住它。#5.8
character_voice.encontent: So these are my private chambers, the first place I may truly call my own.#0|I shall hold this moment dear.#6.6

character_voice.name: 箱中气候
character_voice.content: 一遇上阴雨连绵的天气，这把剑就会在我的血肉里嗡鸣，而火焰也会比平常更加躁动……#0|不，不是害怕被浇灭，而是做足了准备与之对抗。#8.47
character_voice.encontent: Whenever rain falls, I feel the sword pulse with a restless heat more fierce than usual.#0|No, not because it fears extinguishment, but because it revels in the challenge of its threat.#6.33

character_voice.name: 箱中气候
character_voice.content: 一遇上阴雨连绵的天气，这把剑就会在我的血肉里嗡鸣，而火焰也会比平常更加躁动……#0|不，不是害怕被浇灭，而是做足了准备与之对抗。#8.47
character_voice.encontent: Whenever rain falls, I feel the sword pulse with a restless heat more fierce than usual.#0|No, not because it fears extinguishment, but because it revels in the challenge of its threat.#6.33

character_voice.name: 致未来
character_voice.content: 有趣的新事物很多，我忙着一项项接触，#0|即便是那架放光的数字钟也够我想一个下午。#3.38|如果你说的“未来”是更远更深奥的那种，那很抱歉，我现在根本没空去想。#7.28
character_voice.encontent: Every day, I am confronted with a slew of new concepts to comprehend.#0|It took me a full afternoon simply to grasp the workings of that glowing timepiece of yours.#4.86|If this "future" you wish to discuss is any more intricate than that, then forgive me: I fear my mind is already overburdened.#9.43

character_voice.name: 孑立
character_voice.content: ……维尔汀，你快睡着了，休息吧。#0|我？我正在听那台——氛围制造机？这对我来说就是很好的休息。#5.11
character_voice.encontent: ... You're nodding off, Vertin. You would do well to return to your sleeping chamber for a rest.#0|Me? I'm listening to this ... Mood Switch. That serves as rest enough.#7.88

character_voice.name: 问候
character_voice.content: 你好。#0|哦，我不擅长问候，#1.95|那些繁文缛节——兰斯洛特每天都在做的事情，对我来说和“你好”这两个字没有任何区别。#4.4
character_voice.encontent: Greetings ...#0|Oh, niceties have never been my strength.#2.28|Bending words over petty formalities has always better suited Lancelot. To me, a simple "greetings" serves just fine.#6.27

character_voice.name: 朝晨
character_voice.content: 好日子，适合借一台战地摩托出去兜风。#0|我最近在学习换挡的技巧，我知道我可以很快学会……#4.57|“无证驾驶”？什么意思？玛尔纱骑士是“有证驾驶”吗？#9.73
character_voice.encontent: The weather today is perfect for a ride on a combat motorcycle.#0|I'm still learning the art of shifting gears, but I have every confidence I shall master it soon.#4.03|Huh, what do you mean by "unlicensed driving"? Does Lady Marsha hold such a license?#11.25

character_voice.name: 信任-朝晨
character_voice.content: 记忆中，这个时间我总在做骑士训练。#0|我和你一样高的时候，总在训练中被掀翻在地，但我会很快爬起来……#4.87|后来？后来都是我把别人掀翻在地。#12.17
character_voice.encontent: In those blurred memories, I was always training at this hour.#0|I stood barely as tall as you do now back then, always beaten to the ground by my sparring partner.#4|Yet upon catching my breath, I rose again. And later? It was my opponent who bent the knee.#10.27

character_voice.name: 夜暮
character_voice.content: 夜晚的小镇很安静，走在路上，只有虫鸣和风吹拂树叶的声音。#0|但酒馆就是另一个样子了，人们会聚集在那里，通过交谈和碰杯来洗去疲惫。#7.7|没有争斗，没有阴谋，没有谁要杀死谁、谁又被谁杀死。那里只有生活，平淡……但安宁。#15.66
character_voice.encontent: At night, the town streets are so quiet that you hear little else but the chirping of insects and the wind rustling through the leaves.#0|And in the pubs, cups clink amidst merry chatter between friends.#9.75|No feuds. No intrigue. Neither killing nor the fear of being killed. Only life—peaceful, quiet life.#14.65

character_voice.name: 信任-夜暮
character_voice.content: 闭上眼睛，我依然还能看见那艘船。它确认了自己不再是自己，也依然不知道靠岸点在哪儿。#0|或许它根本不需要知道，#14.79|只要明白“这是新的自己，它属于我”，这就够了。#17.74
character_voice.encontent: When I close my eyes, I still see that boat. It has accepted the changes put upon itself, yet it still knows not its destination.#0|Yet perhaps it need not know.#15.85| Perhaps there is only one thing it must be sure of: "This is my new self, a self that belongs to none but me."#22.16

character_voice.name: 帽檐与发鬓
character_voice.content: 我不是很喜欢自己的发色，#0|在曾经的卡美洛，就是这头金发让人们意识到了我是谁。#2.83
character_voice.encontent: I am not particularly fond of my hair.#0|Its color acted almost as its own banner in Camelot, all but crying my name aloud to every passerby.#4.1

character_voice.name: 袖与手
character_voice.content: 痛？这可真是一个陌生的词汇，但的确，这把剑与我血肉相连。把它称之为诅咒或者宿命都有些太重了，#0|现在的我不是很在意它的存在，它只是一把趁手的工具，而我选择了使用它。#13.72
character_voice.encontent: "Pain"? I seldom use such a word to describe my bond with this sword. And "curse" and "fate" carry too much weight.#0|No, I regard it now as little more than a tool—one I choose to use only when needed.#9.25

character_voice.name: 袖与手
character_voice.content: 痛？这可真是一个陌生的词汇，但的确，这把剑与我血肉相连。把它称之为诅咒或者宿命都有些太重了，#0|现在的我不是很在意它的存在，它只是一把趁手的工具，而我选择了使用它。#13.72
character_voice.encontent: "Pain"? I seldom use such a word to describe my bond with this sword. And "curse" and "fate" carry too much weight.#0|No, I regard it now as little more than a tool—one I choose to use only when needed.#9.25

character_voice.name: 衣着与身形
character_voice.content: 穿得像是博物馆的古董确实很蠢，但这也的确是我的一部分。#0|我不会否认它，#5.94|但也谈不上承认它。#7.75
character_voice.encontent: Wearing this armor may make me appear as some relic escaped from a museum, but it is a part of me;#0| that much I will not deny. #6.6|Still, I don't believe I shall ever embrace it wholeheartedly.#9.47

character_voice.name: 嗜好
character_voice.content: 武器已经随时代“迭代”，成为一种更高效的战斗手段。#0|我经常把这些到手的枪械拆解开，试图理解它们如何运作。#3.93|这并不属于神秘术，#8.72|即便是梅林来了，也会和当初的我一样疑惑但好奇。#10.63
character_voice.encontent: The weapons of this modern age are far more efficient than those of the past.#0|By dismantling various firearms, I am hoping to understand their inner workings.#4.46|How bizarre that there is no arcanum involved at all!#10.02|I'm certain that even Merlin himself would be as baffled as I, were he to lay eyes upon them.#14.37

character_voice.name: 嗜好
character_voice.content: 武器已经随时代“迭代”，成为一种更高效的战斗手段。#0|我经常把这些到手的枪械拆解开，试图理解它们如何运作。#3.93|这并不属于神秘术，#8.72|即便是梅林来了，也会和当初的我一样疑惑但好奇。#10.63
character_voice.encontent: The weapons of this modern age are far more efficient than those of the past.#0|By dismantling various firearms, I am hoping to understand their inner workings.#4.46|How bizarre that there is no arcanum involved at all!#10.02|I'm certain that even Merlin himself would be as baffled as I, were he to lay eyes upon them.#14.37

character_voice.name: 赞赏
character_voice.content: 我知道你言出必行，所以我可以将信任交予你。#0|不，这不是什么骑士的承诺，“骑士”这两个字不会让承诺变得更有分量，反之亦然。#4.8|这是我的承诺，我会证明它的有效。#13.87
character_voice.encontent: You are a woman of your word, and thus, you have won my unwavering trust.#0|This is no knightly vow, nor does that word add any weight to a promise.#6.18|I simply give you my word in kind, and that I shall honor to the end.#12.5

character_voice.name: 亲昵
character_voice.content: 如果你有空，或者你需要休息，我们可以回一趟小镇，#0|坐在伯恩的院子里听一会儿鸟叫，看那群孩子去河边捉螃蟹，#4.75|或者上山猎些野味……#9.84|这是无意义的时间消耗，但总能带给我前所未有的平静。#12.89
character_voice.encontent: If you ever need a day to ease your mind, why don't the two of us visit town again? #0|We can sit in Burne's garden and listen to the birds, watch the children crabbing at the river,#5.9|or venture into the woodland by the Tor and hunt wild game.#12| Idle pastimes they may be, yet there is naught else that sets my mind quite at rest as them.#17.28

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 维尔汀，你行走在许多时代之中，#0|以至于我们这些住客也像来自不同时代的藏品——#3.2|反讽？不至于，这只是一个小小的玩笑，我不擅长讲笑话，但我偶尔会尝试。#7.6
character_voice.encontent: Vertin, you've crossed many eras.#0| I suppose that makes me and the other residents here your collection of historical artifacts ...#3.67|No, I didn't mean to be sarcastic—it was meant as a harmless joke. I suppose I must work on my delivery.#10.04

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 维尔汀，你行走在许多时代之中，#0|以至于我们这些住客也像来自不同时代的藏品——#3.2|反讽？不至于，这只是一个小小的玩笑，我不擅长讲笑话，但我偶尔会尝试。#7.6
character_voice.encontent: Vertin, you've crossed many eras.#0| I suppose that makes me and the other residents here your collection of historical artifacts ...#3.67|No, I didn't mean to be sarcastic—it was meant as a harmless joke. I suppose I must work on my delivery.#10.04

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 诗人赞颂骑士，以至于将野蛮浪漫化。#0|我一直不能理解这件事情，即便我曾经也将它作为一种手段，#5.51|但那也只是因为，在那个时代我必须这么选择。#10.86|但是现在不一样了，时代已经改变，我理应有更多选择。#16.02
character_voice.encontent: The bards sang such blind praises of knights, romanticizing cruelty and bloodshed.#0|I myself could never give approval for such acts,#7.47| though I once used them as a means to an end.#10.92|But the world is different now, and we are all presented with greater choices.#15.45

character_voice.name: 独白
character_voice.content: 人们的记忆都掺杂了虚假的部分，这一般是因为人们会美化过去。#0|所以我也不否认我被赋予的记忆，#6.32|但它只是存在着，我们之间隔着一层玻璃。#9.5|夜深人静的时候，我们偶尔对望。#15.14
character_voice.encontent: Memory can deceive at times, leading us to unknowingly glorify our pasts.#0|For that reason, I do not deny the memory imposed upon me.#7.15|Rather, I stand beside it, a pane of glass between us,#13.2|only gazing upon one another in the quiet hours when we are left alone.#18.26

character_voice.name: 入队
character_voice.content: 我应约而来。#0
character_voice.encontent: I am here as promised.#0

character_voice.name: 战前
character_voice.content: 我可不在乎战前礼仪。#0
character_voice.encontent: Sorry, but I don't deal in pre-duel courtesies.#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 你会看清这把剑的锋刃。#0
character_voice.encontent: See for yourself how deep this blade cuts.#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 火焰在躁动。#0
character_voice.encontent: The flames are restless.#0

character_voice.name: 择选高阶咒语
character_voice.content: 总该做个了断。#0
character_voice.encontent: Time to settle this.#0

character_voice.name: 择选至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 它妄图蚕食我？#0
character_voice.encontent: Hmph, does it truly mean to consume me?#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 焚毁有形之物。#0
character_voice.encontent: Burn the tangible.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 它被火锻造，也令火咆哮。#0
character_voice.encontent: Born of fire, and by fire shall it burn.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 焚毁无形之物。#0
character_voice.encontent: Burn the intangible.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 驱散一切幻象。#0
character_voice.encontent: All illusions, begone.#0

character_voice.name: 召唤至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 无论多少次，我都会认清这毫无意义的虚假。#0

skin.name: 德雷克
skin.skinDescription: 谨以此献给他的过去——荆棘、火焰与通向“我”的门径。

1401021.content: 你这里的研究员们似乎很缺帮忙试验的人，那个灰色头发的家伙已经连续几天来敲我的门了。
不过，新时代的科技发明真是有意思极了。
我很少佩服什么人，但他是怎么做到每天都有新点子的？
不同于骑士的剑，那些灵活的小东西可以衍生出无数种战术。
帮他的忙也不赖，多亏他的启发，我的决斗思路都开拓了许多。
副作用？那些小玩意儿还有副作用？
那他刚刚让我试用的什么超级跳跃弹簧鞋套，不会也……

1401022.content: 之前你与你母亲在一起时的样子，让我想起了一些“记忆”。
一些关于我那位“父亲”的事。
嗯，其实这些记忆已经非常遥远而模糊。
我不知道如何形容我对他的感觉，但我已经不再尝试用理智去分析。
是后悔吗？不……哪怕千年前的事再来一次，我想我还是会抛下一切，做我认为对的事。
那段“记忆”最大的价值就是让我知道，原来在千年前，我就在做我认为对的事了。
是的，那些东西无法定义我，我一直在做的就是向前看。
新时代有太多值得看的新东西了——比如，箱中不断冒出来的新杂志。
流行的东西怎么变得那么快？
你能帮我订一些杂志吗？那种有很多照片的，我想多了解一下现在流行的东西。

1401021.content: 就是要小心一些发明的副作用
